hypothesis: Nonnegative Gauss Fq2 multiplication: raw normalized S=a0+a1, N=2p-a1; stream T=b0+b1 and D=b1+2p-b0 per row. Share P=S*b0 between X=P+N*T and Y=P+a0*D. Three raw products, two unsigned CIOS reductions, four raw vector additions per limb pair rather than eight in prior signed method.
math: X=real+2p*(b0+b1), Y=imag+2p*a0. Inputs in[0,2p], p<2^254 imply each accumulator<=12p^2. REDC<R+bound: R256 output<4p permits one conditional subtract2p; R260 output<2p requires none. Prepared arrays may exceed2p and must remain raw limbs. Mixed final48 cancellation mask remains necessary.
